backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with state, types, media storage, tutorials, posts, products, orders, user profiles, tokens, and branding, initializing core systems and storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Provides migration logic converting legacy Stripe config into a new internal multi‑mode Stripe configuration.
backend/token.mo: Implements a token system with balances, minting, transfers, spending, earning, and transaction history tracking using maps and lists.
feature_evidence.json: Describes feature evidence for Stripe settings UI restoration, backend Stripe mode handling, and related frontend query updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains high‑level summaries of multiple frontend files and components across the application.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, identity loading, profile setup modal logic, theming, and global UI components like AI chat and toasts.
frontend/src/components/AddProductDialog: Dialog for creating products with form fields, multi-image upload, preview management, and backend submission.
frontend/src/components/AddTutorialDialo: Dialog to add video tutorials, supporting video upload or selection, metadata fields, and backend submission.
frontend/src/components/admin/BrandingSe: Admin interface for editing site branding, including site name, slogan, logo, and icon uploads with previews and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/admin/HeroSettin: Admin section for updating hero headline, subheadline, and hero image, including image upload with progress and live preview.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersSect: Displays admin order list with loading and empty states, formatting dates, items, payment types, and statuses.
frontend/src/components/admin/PageSettin: Provides forms to edit page titles, subtitles, and banner images with upload, preview, and save logic.
frontend/src/components/admin/PaymentSet: Manages Stripe test/live secret keys and active mode with validation, saving, and config status UI.
frontend/src/components/AIAssistantPanel: UI panel that periodically requests AI feedback for a tutorial and displays guidance and suggestions with enable/disable control.
frontend/src/components/AIChatTutor.tsx: Floating chat widget that handles user chat messages, generates canned AI responses, and displays chat history with auto-scroll.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Shopping cart drawer that manages item quantities, token or Stripe checkout, user profiles, and purchase order handling.
frontend/src/components/checkout/BuyerDe: Reusable form fields for buyer name, phone, and notes with basic validation display.
frontend/src/components/checkout/StripeC: Card checkout form that validates buyer info, saves purchase orders, and clears the cart on success.
frontend/src/components/DepositICPDialog: Empty or placeholder component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/EditProductDialo: Dialog for editing products including fields, image reordering, new image uploads, and saving updates.
frontend/src/components/ExternalBlobImag: Image component that displays ExternalBlob content with loading and error fallbacks.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout with navigation, auth handling, dynamic branding, and cart/balance UI.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Full‑screen loading view with animated music icon and message.
frontend/src/components/MediaLibraryMana: Admin/media manager UI for uploading, listing, and deleting video files with progress tracking and permissions.
frontend/src/components/MintTokensDialog: Dialog for admins to mint tokens by entering recipient principal, amount, and description.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for new users to create a profile with username and bio, then saving via backend.
frontend/src/components/RestoreProductsD: Dialog to restore preset product data, uploading images and creating products sequentially.
frontend/src/components/SendTokensDialog: Dialog for sending tokens to another principal with amount validation and optional description.
frontend/src/components/ShareRecordingDi: Dialog for uploading a video or audio file, creating a media blob with progress, and submitting a new community post.
frontend/src/components/StripeConfigDial: Admin dialog to configure Stripe by submitting a secret key and allowed countries, with support for loading and displaying existing settings.
frontend/src/components/WorkWithUsDialog: Form dialog that collects name, email, and message, then submits a work‑with‑us application via a mutation.
frontend/src/config/appBuildInfo.ts: Provides helpers to read and format build metadata such as version, environment, and build time.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines numerous React Query hooks for interacting with backend actors, covering profiles, branding, media, posts, payments, and admin checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for colors, spacing, and UI components.
frontend/src/lib/cartStore.ts: Implements a Zustand store managing cart items with add, update, remove, clear, and item count operations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, providing React Query and Internet Identity providers around the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Renders the admin dashboard with permission checks and tabs for branding, pages, media, tutorials, products, orders, and payments.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Displays community posts with a banner, actions, and grid layout, supporting sharing recordings and work‑with‑us submissions.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page showing hero section, featured tutorials, featured products, and key features using fetched settings.
frontend/src/pages/LearningPage.tsx: Learning page with difficulty filters, banner settings, and a tutorials grid with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with options to return to the store or home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Handles successful payments by clearing the cart, refreshing queries, showing a success toast, and displaying confirmation UI.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows user profile details, token balance, and links to wallet, uploaded content, and purchased content.
frontend/src/pages/StorePage.tsx: Store page for listing, purchasing, and managing products with admin tools, cart integration, and product dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: React page displaying a user's token wallet with balance, transaction history, and a send-tokens dialog.
frontend/src/types.ts: Shared TypeScript types and enums for roles, tutorials, posts, AI interactions, chat, and token transactions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, animations, typography, container queries, and theme extensions.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing Stripe payment settings restoration requirements, existing features, and pending tasks.
